title: Metering Service Referee Settlement Limits: New Meters and Overdue Periodic Tests
content:
| Meter age and test history at the company test date | Referee settlement limit |
|---|---|
| Installed fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the company test date (the settlement new-meter period) | 6 months (the settlement new-meter limit) |
| Installed 12 whole calendar months or more before the company test date, the meter type has a periodic test interval, and the whole calendar months between the later of the installation date and the latest within-tolerance test date and the company test date exceed that interval | 3 months (the settlement overdue-test limit) |
| Any other meter | No new-meter or overdue-test limit applies |

The limit above bounds the number of whole regular bills a **Metering Service** referee backbill settlement reprices when counting back from the company test date.

**Clause.** Where the meter was installed fewer than the settlement new-meter period of whole calendar months before the company test date, the referee settlement limit is the settlement new-meter limit. Where the meter was installed the settlement new-meter period or more before the company test date, the meter type has a periodic test interval, and the whole calendar months between the later of the installation date and the latest within-tolerance test date and the company test date exceed that interval, the referee settlement limit is the settlement overdue-test limit.

## Intervals by meter type

- Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter, Standard AMI Smart Meter and AMI Bidirectional Net Meter: 0 years, no periodic test interval, so the overdue-test limit never applies.
- AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter: 8 years, 96 whole calendar months.
- AMI Interval Demand Meter: 4 years, 48 whole calendar months.
- Primary Metering Installation: 2 years, 24 whole calendar months.

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical meters)

- Installed 11 whole calendar months before the company test: limit 6. Installed exactly 12: the new-meter limit does not apply.
- AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter, installed long ago, 96 whole calendar months since its latest within-tolerance test: 96 does not exceed 96, no overdue limit. At 97 months: limit 3.
- Primary Metering Installation, installed 40 months before the company test and tested within tolerance 25 months before it: 25 exceeds 24, limit 3.
